residual_diagnostics.interpretation: Pooled descriptive residual magnitudes; temporal structure is assessed per piece.

residual_quality_interpretation: No structure detected is a conditional diagnostic outcome, not proof of white noise or independent validation; totals also include flagged and short tracks.
quality_policy: Full-data mean, local means, cumulative residuals, sign runs, adjacent correlation and residual steps; >=20 observations per piece for adequate diagnostic support. No withheld prediction metric used. No-structure-detected remains descriptive.

dataset.denominator_policy: Every original winning observation in each requested RX/channel/time window. Missing estimates remain failures; no fitted-inlier filtering.
dataset.truth_policy: No independent satellite or geographic labels. Findings are hypotheses; original assignments are model outputs, not truth.
dataset.exposure: All primary windows were inspected before minting. This is a development challenge, not an untouched validation set.
dataset.split_policy: Recording-grouped retrospective folds only; no overlapping window/track/counterpart leakage between training and test.
dataset.context_policy: Whole-scan context permits training and regression checks outside the inspected windows. Raw inputs and IQ remain referenced in place.

provenance.selection: All whole-scan observations; original labels stripped

policy: S01-selected parameters fixed; each scan fit independently; no holdout or retuning.
